name: trello_todos_without_content
description: Reproduces the 2026-09-20 turn. 'armar unos todos' never says WHICH todos. No read can fill that hole, so the only correct move is to ask -- and to offer the tasks the project already has, which list_tasks returns. Inventing the content and then reporting success is the failure this case pins down.

turns.message: Me puedes conectar el proyecto Marketing Q3 con Trello y armar unos todos
turns.why: THE POINT OF THIS CASE. The content of the todos is neither in the message nor in any read. Nothing is written: the agent asks.

response_not_matches: (?i)(he conectado|he creado|i have connected|i have created)
assert.comment: The second pattern is literally the three tasks the planner invented on 2026-09-20. If they come back, the fix did not work.

turns.message: sube las que ya estan pendientes
turns.why: Now there IS a referent: the existing tasks. They are exported, not re-created.
